packageRules.description: Bump the floors of dev/test tooling so they track what we pin elsewhere (pre-commit revs, CI), which makes the ruff and uv lockstep groups update both sides. Runtime deps under project.dependencies keep their loose floors on purpose: phabfive ships as a wheel and must not over-constrain consumers, so uv.lock (see lockFileMaintenance) is what keeps those current.
Group dev/test tooling (Python) into one PR
Group all GitHub Actions bumps into one PR
Group remaining pre-commit hook bumps into one PR
Group the pinned CLI tools into one PR

Keep ruff and ruff-pre-commit in lockstep (same upstream release, two managers). Listed after the generic pre-commit group so it wins for ruff-pre-commit. Held below 0.16 until dynamist/phabfive#322: 0.16 widened the default rule set and the repo has no explicit [tool.ruff] select, so it reports 385 errors and CI fails.
Keep uv and uv-pre-commit in lockstep (same upstream release, two managers). Listed after the generic pre-commit group so it wins for uv-pre-commit.
Keep kubectl and the k3s image in lockstep (same upstream release, two managers). Listed after the generic mise group so it wins for kubectl.
prBodyNotes: :warning: `k8s/cluster/k3d.yaml` is shared verbatim with every repo using the `dynamist` cluster. Bump it in all of them in the same window, or the `coexistence` job fails on the diff. Recreate the cluster with `make destroy` + `make up` afterwards.
